title: Big Island in a Day: Volcanoes Waterfalls Sightseeing and History
overview: The Big Island of Hawaii has a diverse ecosystem unlike anywhere else on the planet, and on this day-long nature tour, experience the beauty of its black-sand beaches, thundering waterfalls, and Hawaii Volcanoes National Park. If you’re lucky, find Hawaiian green sea turtles basking on the coast.
inclusions: Small Group Tour Lead by a Professional Guide
Kona/ Kohala Coast area hotel pickup and drop-off

title: Hilo Shore Excursion: Volcanoes National Park and Rainbow Falls
overview: Sample a cross-section of outdoor sights on the Big Island during this shore excursion exploring Volcanoes National Park, waterfall, black sand beach and more. Discover the postcard-perfect Rainbow Falls before visiting the amazing volcanic steam vents and unique geology around Kilauea Volcano. Before your day is done, check out a local macadamia nut farm and visit a gorgeous black sand beach. A guide, park entrance fees, and round-trip port transport are included.
itineraryStops: Mauna Loa Macadamia Nut Visitor Center
inclusions: Port / Hilo Hotel pickup and drop-off
What to bring/wear: Walking shoes, light sweater, camera, hat, sunglasses
Stop is made to purchase food

title: Big Island GOAT Experience: Mauna Kea Summit, Sunset & Stars
overview: Enjoy a sunset and stargazing experience like no other on this small-group trip to Mauna Kea—the highest point in the Hawaiian islands. Following afternoon pickup, travel in a 4x4 van to the summit—you can change into the provided warm jacket and pair of gloves, and sip a hot beverage, as the sun starts to set. Then, learn why so many research telescopes are located here during a brilliant celestial show.
inclusions: Jackets and gloves to keep you warm
FREE night photo with our professional camera

title: Small Group Big Island Twilight Volcano and Stargazing Tour
overview: Pack in some of Hawaii’s most mesmerizing sights during this Big Island full-day and twilight volcano tour. Sample Kona-grown coffee from a local coffee farm, taste Hawaiian sweet bread at Punalu’u Bakery, and look for sea turtles at Punalu'u Black Sand Beach. Then, explore Volcanoes National Park before ending your experience by stargazing in a secluded location—perfect for taking in views of the night sky.
inclusions: Use of Rain and Warm Jacket
Kona/ Kohala Coast area hotel pickup and drop-off
Small-group tour lead by a professional guide

title: Big Island Highlights: Coffee, Volcano, Black Sands & Waterfall
overview: Spend a full day exploring the Big Island with visits to waterfalls, beaches, tropical valleys, stunning viewpoints, and so much more. Learn about Kona’s coffee culture with a visit to Greenwell Coffee Farm, for an insider's perspective and to sample the locally cultivated coffee. See Hawaii’s natural beauty at Punalu’u Black Sands Beach, where you can look out for Hawaiian green sea turtles, make multiple stops in Volcanoes National Park, and soak up the beauty of Rainbow Falls all in a day.

title: Deluxe Volcano Experience with Restaurant Dinner
overview: Witness the raw power of one of the world's largest and most dynamic volcanoes on this full-day, small-group excursion. Discover the island's coffee region and enjoy lunch at Greenwell Farms. Look out for sea turtles at Punalu's Black Sand Beach before taking in the scenery at Volcanoes National Park. End with a 3-course dinner at an acclaimed Volcano restaurant.

title: Volcanoes National Park Safari
overview: Fly away from Hilo Airport and into a world of volcanoes, rainbows, and waterfalls. With this family-run helicopter company—the longest-running on the island—you’ll meet your captain, get debriefed on safety protocol, and hop into your helicopter for a wild aerial adventure. With your captain doubling as guide, you’ll explore the volcanoes of the national park, lava flows, orchid farms, lush forests, and so much more.

title: Volcano National Park Adventure From Kona
overview: Many tours can take you to Volcanoes National Park, but only this one lets you spend your day with a geologist who can provide information that others can't. This small-group geology-based tour offers a far richer experience of the world's most active volcano, Kilauea, than you'd get anywhere else. You also visit a coffee farm, Rainbow Falls, and Punaluu Black Sand Beach.
inclusions: Water, drinks. Coats, raincoats, and umbrellas

title: Big Island Volcano Adventure from Kona: Small Group
overview: The Big Island is one of the most diverse places on earth. For visitors, it can be difficult to comprehend the vastness of the island's diversity but this tour offers the chance to immerse yourself in it. You'll explore the rainforests and waterfalls along Mauna Kea's Hamakua Coast and the summit of the active volcano Kilauea in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, before watching Kilauea's lava lake glowing after sunset.

title: Private Guide Meet In Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
overview: Discover the awe-inspiring landscapes of the Hawaii Volcanoes National Park with a private certified guide. Meet your guide at the park and set out on a thrilling tour of the park's lava flows, viewpoints, and eruption sites. Travel in the comfort of a luxury Mercedes van and enjoy an itinerary customized for your group, whether you want to hike through lava fields or just soak up the scenery.

title: Big Island: Discover Hilo Helicopter Tour
overview: The best way to see Hawaii’s steaming vents and glowing lava has always been like the birds. You’ll get that feeling on this helicopter tour, soaring above one of the most volcanically active islands on the planet. Getting the pilot’s commentary via headphones, you’ll witness waterfalls, craters, the craggy coastline, and—if you're lucky—the volcano’s fiery glow.
inclusions: Pilot Guide who are also State of Hawaii Certified Tour Guides
Use of Bose Aviation-grade, electronic noise-cancelling headsets
Use of microphones with 2-way communication with pilot

title: Big Island Spectacular Helicopter Tour
overview: Fly above Hawaii's spectacular peaks, coasts, and valleys on this helicopter tour of the Big Island. Watch lava bubble up out of volcanoes, fly over the lush rain forests of the Hamakua Coast, and complete your trip with views of the waterfalls lining the Kohala Mountains. Only a helicopter tour lets you see so many of Hawaii's charms on a single ride and from an unforgettable perspective.
inclusions: Use of Bose Aviation-grade, electronic noise-cancelling headsets
Use of microphones with 2-way communication with pilot
Pilot Guide who are also State of Hawaii Certified Tour Guides

title: Private Big Island Experience: 3 of 4 Window Seats
overview: This comprehensive helicopter tour of the Big Island treats you like a VIP. Take your Hawaii adventure to the skies, departing from Kona International Airport. Your pilot narrates the terrain below, including valleys, waterfalls, coastline, and—of course—an active volcano. You’ll head straight to Kilauea via the saddle running between Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa, Hawaii’s tallest mountains.
inclusions: All taxes, fees and handling charges

title: Private Shore Excursion Hilo Volcanoes National Park up to 11 PPL
overview: This fully narrated tour is ideal for families and small groups, thanks to a maximum size of 11 people. Explore Volcanoes National Park with an expert guide and experience the excitement of the number one tour on the Big Island. You'll make stops at the Liliuokalani Japanese Gardens, Hilo town, Thurston Lave Tube, plus Rainbow Falls, and several other Hawaii highlights. Whether you're a first-time visitor or returning to the Big Island for another look, this tour is right for you!
inclusions: Mercedes Benz Sprinter van 10 Passenger Dual Air Conditioning
Park Fees for Volcanoes National Park
